title: ICG：基于多模态大语言模型提示与个性化偏好对齐的封面图像生成改进
summary: 提出ICG框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行提示，并结合个性化偏好对齐，生成高质量、上下文相关的封面图像。通过元标记提取语义特征，使用用户嵌入进行个性化，并采用多奖励学习策略优化。实验表明ICG在图像质量、语义保真度和个性化方面显著提升。
summary_en: Proposes ICG, a framework integrating MLLM-based prompting with personalized preference alignment for high-quality cover image generation. It extracts semantic features via meta tokens, personalizes with user embeddings, and uses multi-reward learning. Experiments show improvements in image quality, semantic fidelity, and personalization.
